entities.summary: Helsingborg Arena is a multipurpose arena in Helsingborg, Sweden, run by and associated with the municipal companies Helsingborg Events and Idrottspark AB and Helsingborg Arena and Scen AB, respectively. Helsingborg Arena is a event venue in Europe, established in 2012. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
